cultural_context.rule: Describe Villa Ukika as a contemporary, living Yagán community context with cultural continuity. Do not reduce it to a static tourist attraction or a frozen ethnographic site, and do not use 'last descendants' wording.

provisional_context.distance_to_puerto_williams: SERNATUR provincial tourism guide describes Villa Ukika as located about one kilometer from Puerto Williams; this is a provisional contextual claim and requires authoritative geospatial confirmation.

prohibited_inferences: Villa Ukika is merely a tourist attraction or a frozen ethnographic site.
Villa Ukika is the place where 'the last descendants' of the Yagán people live.
Villa Ukika is the same settlement as Puerto Williams.
The ~1 km distance from Puerto Williams is authoritative geometry.
SERNATUR tourism-map positions are canonical Atlas coordinates.
Villa Ukika can be visited year round or without current culturally appropriate verification.
